diagnostics.summary: argument `value` for `List.push` uses `take` but the parameter is `read`.
diagnostics.label: data effect mismatch
causes: A bare argument is `read`; `mut` and `take` must be written explicitly and match the parameter.

fixes.title: Remove `take` from `value`: a `read` parameter takes the bare value.

diagnostics.label: unknown callee
causes: The callee is not a user function, known type constructor, enum variant, or builtin signature.

fixes.title: Declare the function or add a builtin signature for this API.

diagnostics.summary: retaining API `List.push` cannot retain local value `reading`.
diagnostics.label: local value retained

fixes.title: Pass `value` through `manage reading` before retaining it.
